Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: A big one: redesigned the Social section (Live Shows, DJ List, DJ Profiles, and the Add/Edit Listing form) with glowing gradient cards, a two-column edit form with a live preview, and proper empty/loading states. DJ Profiles can now be liked and followed right from the full profile page. Settings got the same design pass - every section is a tinted panel now, with hand-drawn sliders/toggles/segmented pickers instead of native controls, and General/Broadcast/Spotify use the full window width in two columns. You can now pick a show image before ever going live instead of only after. Also fixed: the window border sitting on top of other Dalamud windows while unfocused, text fields blending into their own panels, the Live Shows/DJ List tab switch snapping instead of animating smoothly, and the Deck view sitting closer to the window's left edge than the right.
